Name: AutoPincher

Description: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: I Am Ready
Punchline: Automatically accept or decline Duty Finder ready checks based on a configurable counter.
Description:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool

Author: Akari
Name: Mahjong Advisor
Punchline: Discard advice and optional auto-play for Doman Mahjong.
Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand, discards, dora, scores and called melds, then ranks each discard by hand speed against deal-in risk. Auto-play and file logging are on by default in this build: sit at a casual table and it plays, then /mjadv bundle packages the logs for support. /mjadv stop or the Automation tab returns to manual suggestions instantly. Discard piles and meld strips are found automatically; the node tools are only a fallback.
Changelog: v0.4.4.0: Chi picker freeze fix. When a call prompt's claimed tile could not be identified, the single-shape chi gate counted shapes for the wrong tile: each candidate offered one run, but the actual tile completed two, so the game opened its shape-selection dialog - which ignores call callbacks - and the match froze (live at South 4 while leading 38,400; bundle 20261030-081345). Chi now fires only when the claim is pinned to one tile, or when every tile that could legally be on offer completes exactly one run; anything else passes instead. The picker-stall warning also logs once rather than every frame. The stale Advisor block that earlier builds wrote into the plugin config is no longer serialised: it was never read, is ignored on load, and disappears at the next config save. An experimental rollout-search re-ranking of discard candidates is included but ships OFF: a 240-match paired simulator A/B (two seeds) rejected it - it traded a 39% relative win-rate drop for nothing - so it stays a foundation for later work. v0.4.3.0: Result-screen retry. The result panel can swallow the first advance callback while it animates; the controller fired it twice and then its acted guard blocked every retry, leaving the screen waiting indefinitely (live Advanced freeze, state 29 unresolved for 12s). Advances now retry every 2.5 seconds while the result state persists, capped at 8 attempts so the deliberately manual match-end screen is not spammed. v0.4.2.0: Match-level tuning. A full hanchan evaluator now plays East+South with real score accounting, dealer rotation, honcha, riichi sticks and placement, and 120 paired matches showed the old risk settings were too passive. Win value 1800 and deal-in cost 4000 beat 1300/5200 on identical deals (average place 2.55 vs 2.65, more firsts, fewer fourths) with the deal-in rate unchanged at 9.3%. A v7 config migration applies the new values. Riichi hand value and placement stance were also tested and left unchanged - both were flat across 60-match arms. v0.4.1.0: Advanced-table defence. Cross-seat genbutsu now uses the pond lengths captured at the instant a riichi marker appears; the old turn-count shortcut broke once calls shortened ponds and could mark a tile discarded before the riichi as safe. Two declared riichi also force a fold for any hand that is not tenpai, overriding the placement chase. The simulator now records the same declaration snapshots: over 1,000 hands the defence fix moved deal-in rate from 10.3% to 9.5% and average points from -22 to +17, while the double-riichi rail was neutral there because the simulation has no placement stance. Live Advanced trial on 0.4.0.0 finished 1st, 4th, then leading when stopped; the 4th lost two deal-ins to one riichi player, the second 12,000 while two were in riichi. v0.4.0.0: Exact scoring core. Completed hands are now scored by yaku, fu, dora and the payment table (closed and open, riichi through yakuman), and the offline simulator uses that scoring for win legality and payouts. Ready-hand valuation was built and benchmarked but stays out of live decisions: over 1,500 simulated hands, mixing exact tenpai values with the existing one-away estimate cut the win rate from 15.4% to 8.1%, so the value scale must be unified for every shanten first. Advice is memoised per table state so the overlay and controller do not recompute the same decision. v0.3.10.0: Silent-endgame defence. The threat model measured a silent opponent as at most 19% likely tenpai, so on a table with no riichi and no melds every safety rule stayed off - the controller pushed one-away hands with 6-9 tiles left to draw into damaten twice in one match (4,200 and 2,200 deal-ins) and paid full tsumo on 14,300 and 20,000 hands. Silent seats now take on a readiness floor that rises from zero at wall 32 to a concrete threat at wall 16, arming the existing late-wall fold and per-tile safety ranking on quiet tables. v0.3.9.0: Chi freeze fixed. The shape-selection dialog ignores scripted call picks (confirmed by the first picker dump), so chi now only fires when exactly one shape is possible - that path completes with no dialog. Multi-shape chi passes instead of stalling; the pass log records how many shapes were declined. v0.3.8.0: Late-wall defence. When an opponent is a concrete threat and the wall is down to the last four go-arounds, the controller folds any hand that is not tenpai instead of pushing a 1-shanten no-riichi hand. This was the 12,000 deal-in in the first match. Diagnostic bundles now also include chi picker dumps. The end-of-match results screen still waits for you by design - that is the one click after a match. v0.3.7.0: Chi is now fully automated. The controller calls chi when the advisor ranks it best, and if the client shows the shape-selection surface it fires the first variant and re-evaluates the hand. The picker layout is dumped once per session to the log folder so shape-specific selection can be refined against real captures. A v6 config migration enables chi. v0.3.6.0: Read each opponent meld strip independently. A hidden empty strip for one quiet seat no longer suppresses every visible meld on the table, so the threat model sees called sets when they exist. This is a readiness/defence accuracy change; automation logic is unchanged. v0.3.5.0: Fix the second freeze. A complete open hand is no longer assumed to be a legal tsumo: the controller checks for an actual yaku and keeps discarding when there is none. Call prompts now prefer the newest board addition over a possibly stale pond tile (the live log claimed 6z/dragon while the actual Pon was 9m), and the log records the last discard tile/seat. A v5 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging. v0.3.4.0: Fix the self-kan freeze. A Kan/Pass bar at state 6 is ignored and the normal discard proceeds instead of firing a Pass callback the client ignores. Session stats are preserved after /mjadv stop so the bundle still shows the run, and a v4 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging for the next launch. v0.3.3.0: Reset the exposed tuning sliders to the fitted win-rate defaults (base hand value 1300, deal-in 5200, noten 1500, opponent hand 4000) with a one-time v3 config migration. Diagnostic bundles now include the actual Dalamud plugin config file from pluginConfigs. v0.3.2.0: State 15 is now treated as the generic other-players state unless real call buttons are present, state 22 (forced riichi discard) is automated, and state 27 (between-hands result/score) is recognised instead of showing stale advice. Overlay/advice are now gated to actual decision states, and diagnostic bundles can read the Dalamud log while it is open. v0.3.1.0: Auto-play and file logging are now on by default, /mjadv session starts a clean logged session, and /mjadv bundle packages the recent JSONL logs, config, layouts, Dalamud log tail and a full last-read snapshot into one zip. Status changes are now logged as auto-status records. v0.3.0.1: Re-arm auto-play on a state change even when the hand happens to repeat, and wait for the Riichi/Pass prompt to close before cutting the riichi tile. v0.3.0.0: Optional auto-play. Replays the client's FireCallback protocol for discards, calls, riichi, ron/tsumo and result advancement, using the reference solver's live-verified handshake and timing guards. Off by default; /mjadv auto [on/off] or /mjadv stop toggles it. Pon/ron/tsumo/riichi are enabled by default, chi and kan are opt-in, the chi shape picker pauses for a manual choice, and the new-hand screen is never auto-advanced. Added /mjadv hand and /mjadv options diagnostics. v0.2.0.2: Keep the previous wall count, so the wall-jump half of new-hand detection actually fires. v0.2.0.1: Reset the pond baselines at the start of a new hand, so the first discard of the hand is tracked and the first call prompt gets the right claimed tile. v0.2.0.0: Meld containers now read by default (112-115 families), with a fail-closed check against our own called-meld count. Own meld tiles are recovered from hand deltas when nodes are unavailable, so ukeire no longer counts tiles already in a call. Riichi detection is marker-node only; the dead rotation and score-drop paths are gone. One node-tree walk per read instead of up to seven. Fixed dead hands getting a nonzero win rate and Pass inventing a yaku path. Red-five decoding accepts both absolute and alias ids. Removed the obsolete fold-threshold setting. Setup window no longer reopens every launch. Added /mjadv melds diagnostics and richer log records.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Zodiac Helper
Punchline: Companion for ZodiacBuddy Reborn: automates the Novus, Nexus, Zodiac and Zeta steps of the ARR relics.
Description: Early beta. Helper for the ARR Zodiac relic line that works next to ZodiacBuddy Reborn. Infuses the materia you hold into your Sphere Scrolls, hands your relics to Jalzahn for each upgrade, and farms Light and Mahatmas through AutoDuty, with Remon attaching the next Mahatma. Optional: AutoDuty for the farms, vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs, Lifestream for inn rooms.
TestingChangelog:
0.8.61, changes since 0.8.0:
- Atma farm with Rotation Solver and BossMod off: an enemy from outside the FATE that hits you is no longer targeted while you are synced in the FATE. Rotation Solver's IgnoreNonFateInFate setting, on by default, never attacks it, so in manual mode the character stood looking at it and the FATE timed out. The farm now goes for the FATE's enemies.
- Book FATEs keep the enemy already targeted instead of picking the nearest again every moment, which flipped between two Ixali and walked the player back and forth. Line of sight now uses the game's own check for spells ("Target not in line of sight"); the scenery ray of 0.8.59 called open ground blocked.
- Line of sight: the book run (enemies, leves) and the Atma farm no longer stop at range when a rock or wall stands between the player and the target; they walk closer until it is in sight. The book run also picks an enemy in sight first. A Dullahan behind a rock in the North Shroud kept the player standing still.
- Labor of Love: the path now rides on the ground to the front of Guiding Star's stall in Mor Dhona and talks from there. WigglyQuest flew onto the stall roof, 3.9 yalms above her, and gave up the hand-in.
- Escort leve (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort does not move for 12 seconds after a /beckon, the player walks back down to it and leads it again 6 yalms to one side, then the other. Before, it beckoned from a rock the mine hound could not reach for 9 minutes.
- Book run: a walk or ride that stops moving for 6 seconds now steps aside and takes the route again, and after three tries sets that target aside. The walk to K'leytai in Mor Dhona stood still for 26 minutes.
- Zodiac material quests: a quest WigglyQuest failed to take was marked done for the weapon, because the game still lists it complete from the first weapon. Now a quest counts as done only after it was in the journal.
- Sylphlands Sentinel: the book run flies to a fixed open spot near the sentinels and lands there. Before, it flew to them under the Sylphlands trees and hovered without landing.
- Second weapon check: the material quests alongside the books now also count a character as past its first relic by the achievements Lethal Weapon (Obtain a Zodiac Weapon) or The Letter Z, or by a Zodiac or Zeta weapon held, besides "Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac". The achievement ids checked before were wrong.
- Autopilot Poetics plan: with the material quests alongside the books, the 2 Sacred Spring Waters of the first hand-ins (A Ponze of Flesh, A Treasured Mother, 400 Poetics) count toward the Animus step, so the ARF run before the books covers them. The other 2 (Labor of Love, Method in His Malice) stay with the Zodiac step. Items already handed in no longer show as needed.
- Zodiac material quests: the plugin takes them itself by talking to Papana, Guiding Star, Adkin and Brangwine. WigglyQuest answered "Could not retrieve next quest step" on A Ponze of Flesh and the character stood still. WigglyQuest still does the hand-ins. The quest talks no longer answer Yes to a prompt that is not from the NPC, such as the Lodestone playguide one.
- Books count per weapon. The game keeps one book at a time, bound to one weapon, and the Bravura's finished Skyearth I read as the Thyrus' ninth book: the autopilot sent the Thyrus Atma to Jalzahn with no books done. The 9 books now count as done only when G'jusana shows every set complete for the weapon in hand. A finished book, or one of a weapon past the books, is thrown away when she offers it for the next one. An unfinished book of another weapon stops the purchase and says so.
- Relic gearset: your own gearsets are never written any more. With the relic in hand on a gearset that saves another weapon you still have, a new gearset is made for the relic, as the Novus step already did. 0.8.48 and earlier overwrote the WHM gearset with the unfinished Thyrus. A gearset that saves a relic or a weapon that is gone is still updated. During A Relic Reborn, when WigglyQuest puts your own gearset on, the relic gearset goes back on.
- Jalzahn trips: the gearset switch that takes the relic off skips gearsets whose weapon is gone. The WHM gearset still held the unfinished Thyrus after the Zenith trade, the game asked "Replace it with Thyrus Zenith?" and the trip stopped. The relic gearset option now also saves a later stage of the relic over a weapon that is gone.
- Books: new option "Zodiac material quests alongside the books", off by default, for a second weapon on. The book run takes the four material quests and hands them in before each book and each objective, and buys the books in the smart order. 10 of the quests' 16 dungeon drops then come from the books' dungeons. The other 6 dungeons and the HQ hand-ins stay for the Nexus to Zodiac step. It buys only the first hand-ins' items and keeps 100 Poetics for the next book.
- Atma farm: FATEs with 2 minutes or less left are not picked. They ended before the farm arrived and fought.
- Atma farm: FATEs that last more than 15 minutes, like Lazy for You at 30 minutes, are left for others. They are made for many players. A checkbox under the Atma farm turns this off.
- Report a problem: the .log file now starts with a Now section (zone, position, job, WigglyQuest's quest and step, the autopilot's step, the job list and every runner at work) and also keeps WigglyQuest's lines and the warnings of other plugins. A line that repeats within a minute is counted instead of written again.
- A Relic Reborn, step 10 (the quest enemies): the character stood still in Outer La Noscea because the spawn centre is off the navmesh. It now looks up to 60 y around it for a spot it can walk to and waits there.
- Mini window and status: while A Relic Reborn runs, they show the quest step out of 19 and what it asks for (for example step 7 of 19, Amdapor Keep). Before, the mini window showed no progress for a job without a relic, and the status kept an old restart note.
- A Relic Reborn on a second job: the step that examines the destination at the Weeping Saint (Chimera) or the Hall of the Bestiarii (Hydra) is skipped when the destination is gone. It is gone once an earlier relic opened the trial, and WigglyQuest waited on it until it gave up.
- A Relic Reborn: once Gerolt has the weapon (sequence 4 on), the autopilot no longer buys and melds another one. The Main tab lists it as handed in.
- Mini window: the Mahatma bars from 0.8.37 never showed, and the window stopped drawing after the step line while the Mahatmas were farmed. Fixed.
- Mini window: an error while drawing it no longer replaces it with Dalamud's error panel. It goes to the log with the part of the window it came from.
- Main tab: a job list under Job. Add the jobs to do after the picked one and order them with Up and Down. When a job reaches the target stage, the autopilot switches to the next job's gearset and goes on with its relic. Jobs already at the target are skipped.
- Mini window: while the Mahatmas are farmed it shows the weapon's Mahatmas out of 12 and the attached Mahatma's points out of 40.
- Main tab: the Bombard Core row has a Buy button. It goes to your Grand Company quartermaster and exchanges seals for the missing cores you can afford, then stops. The material quests also use it when ADS has no route to him.
- When ADS cannot buy a Bombard Core, ZodiacHelper goes to your Grand Company's quartermaster and exchanges the seals itself. ADS had no route to the Storm Quartermaster in Limsa. It only confirms when the game's prompt names the item.
- The Zodiac material quests check your Grand Company rank before buying a Bombard Core. The quartermaster only sells it from Second Lieutenant (rank 9), so below that the run stops and says so, instead of passing on ADS's "No reachable, unlocked NPC route".
- Mmmmmm, Soulglazed Relics, Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac and The Vital Title are done by ZodiacHelper instead of WigglyQuest. Next to Jalzahn it talks to him straight away, and again 1.5 seconds later when the next step is him too. Gerolt, 45 yalms away, is reached on the mount without flying. If a talk fails, WigglyQuest takes over as before.
- The market board limits (gil cap per trip, most per unit over Universalis, never above) now also show in the main tab, under "Buy from market board" when it is ticked. They are the same settings as in the Novus tab.
- Animus to Novus takes the Animus out of your hands before talking to Jalzahn. With it equipped, the game refused the enhancement and the step stopped after 45 seconds.
- Gear repair, on by default: between targets of the books, the Atma farm and between autopilot steps, a worn piece at or below 30 % (set in the main tab) gets repaired. Self repair with Dark Matter goes first. Anything still worn after that goes to Alistair, the mender in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks. If a repair fails, the run goes on and tries again 30 minutes later.
- Books: the 4 second take-off check now starts once vnavmesh has found the route. Long flights, such as across Coerthas, took 4 seconds to plan, so the check cancelled the route and the character rode on the ground instead.
- Messages about missing gear or materia no longer tell Free Trial accounts to buy them. They say the market board is not available and to craft the gear or extract the materia. This covers A Relic Reborn's weapon, the meld step, the HQ Zodiac materials and the Novus materia.
- The autopilot stops before A Relic Reborn when you lack the weapon Gerolt asks for (Barbarian's Bardiche for Bravura, and so on) with its 2 materia melded and cannot buy it. The popup names the weapon and why it was not bought. Before, WigglyQuest talked to Gerolt in a loop.
- On a Free Trial account the "Buy from market board" box shows unticked and cannot be changed. Your saved choice stays for other accounts.
- On a Free Trial account the materia row of the main tab says "by hand (Free Trial)" instead of "autopilot", since nothing is bought on the market board there.
- Report a problem now writes the .log file and copies your text, then gives two buttons: one opens this plugin's thread on our Discord, the other is the server invite for people who are not members yet, since the thread link does not open for them.
- Capture leves also take an armour piece off when one hit removes more than 30 % of a target's HP, before it can die. A level 70 summoner took a winter nix from 100 % to 42 % with one auto-attack.
- Capture leves fight the other spawns that attack you, like the Ragged Hippogryph, with the normal AI and rotation instead of the auto-attack alone, then turn them off again for the targets.
- Report a problem now opens our Discord instead of a GitHub issue. Send the .log file to Kyuuso by DM or post it in the plugin's thread in #plugins. The text you typed is copied to the clipboard so you can paste it with the file.
- Capture leves keep your armour on at first. Each target that dies before the /soothe takes one more piece off for that job and level, body and legs first, and the count is saved. A level 100 character may lose a few targets the first time while it learns.
- Free Trial accounts skip every market board purchase and the main tab says so, since the game does not let them use the market board.
- Capture leves no longer switch to normal combat after riding to the next target. Before, the AI came back on and attacked a winter nix that was already pacified.
- Capture leves start the auto-attack with the hotbar's Auto-attack command. The old call got "Cannot execute at this time." with the weak weapon on, so the targets were never hit.
- Capture leves send the chocobo away and turn off the BossMod AI, its preset and Rotation Solver, even when you had them on. Only the auto-attack hits the targets, so a skill or the chocobo no longer kills one before the /soothe.
- Capture leves in the books no longer swap between the weak weapon and the Atma weapon every second. The Atma weapon goes back on after the targets are soothed, before the turn-in.
- The books summon the chocobo companion with Gysahl Greens for their enemies and FATEs, as the Atma farm already did. Leves stay without it, so it cannot kill a capture target.
- Escort leves (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort falls more than 20 yalms behind, the character walks back to it. It used to stay up to 30 yalms ahead, stuck on a rock, sending /beckon that the game answered with "Too far away".
- Dungeon unlocks that need another dungeon cleared first (Halatali before Halatali (Hard)) wait until you are out of it. The clear used to count when the last boss died, so the talk to Hugubert started inside Halatali, three teleports failed, and the book stopped on Mumuepo the Beholden.
- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.
- Jalzahn's furnace is used from (445.9, -66.3), where it worked by hand. When WigglyQuest hovers at Gerolt or the furnace, it lands and walks in.
- The "Do you really want to trade a high-quality item?" prompt is answered on quests Zodiac Helper started.
- Main tab: materia and the class weapon read "autopilot" when market buying is on.
Still to test before 1.0: party sharing between two clients, and a second relic on the same character.
